description: This Java interface defines a repository for OAuth2 client entities, including various query methods for retrieving OAuth2 client data based on different criteria such as tenant ID, domain name, platform type, package name, and more. It also includes methods for deleting and checking propagation status.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for OAuth2ClientEntity, providing methods for querying OAuth2 client data from the database.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of OAuth2ClientEntity objects filtered by tenant ID and optional search text.

methods.name: findEnabledByDomainNameAndPlatformType
methods.description: Finds enabled OAuth2 clients associated with a specific domain name and platform filter.

methods.name: findEnabledByAndroidPkgNameAndPlatformType
methods.description: Finds enabled OAuth2 clients associated with a specific Android package name and platform filter.

methods.name: findEnabledByIosPkgNameAndPlatformType
methods.description: Finds enabled OAuth2 clients associated with a specific iOS package name and platform filter.

methods.name: findByDomainId
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth2 clients associated with a specific domain ID.

methods.name: findByMobileAppBundleId
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth2 clients associated with a specific mobile app bundle ID.

methods.name: findAppSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the app secret for a specific OAuth2 client, package name, and platform type.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes OAuth2 clients associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds OAuth2 clients by tenant ID and a list of client IDs.

methods.name: isPropagateToEdge
methods.description: Checks if OAuth2 client propagation to edge is enabled for a given tenant and client ID.
